findings.location: Paragraph about discipleship (third paragraph following the image: "Something new in this issue is the beginning of a series by Brother Donald Brechbill on “discipleship”.")
findings.source_quote: Something new in this issue is the beginning of a series by Brother Donald Brechbill on “discipleship”. Disciple has almost the same spelling as discipline. For many, discipline carries a negative connotation, which hopefully will not interfere with the reader being drawn to what Brother Donald has to share.
